idea-plugin.name: COPPA Notice Lint
idea-plugin.description:
18 clauses of the amended COPPA Rule, checked against the notice in your repo

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → COPPA Notice Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 18 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/coppa-notice-lint-2026 (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/coppa-notice-lint-2026

action.text: COPPA Notice Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run COPPA Notice Lint on the file in the editor
